domain.name: Consumer App
domain.description: Everyday utility and productivity software — the agent reads/writes structured personal data and calls a modest set of well-known tools.

governance.name: Human Approval Queue
governance.description: The agent proposes a batch of actions; a human reviews and approves before anything executes.

latency.name: Scheduled / Deferred (minutes–days)
latency.description: Clock-driven or long-horizon work — cron-like recurrence, slow calibration, periodic audits.

pitch: A consumer app governed by human approval queue, operating at scheduled / deferred (minutes–days) latency.
